description.value: You've hauled scrap and wounded allies alike across miles of ash-fall with nothing but grit. While Long Jumping, High Jumping, or Climbing, you can carry one additional bulk of gear or an unconscious ally's Bulk without penalty to the check.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule-element key adjusts carrying capacity or Bulk limits during a specific skill action; encumbrance is derived from the actor's own Bulk totals, not modifiable per-action.
